in_sanskrit.name: हर्षली
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who brings joy to Sharkar

in_marathi.name: Harshali
in_marathi.long_meaning: Harshali हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Harshali is derived from the Sanskrit words harsh (mountain) and ali (waves), hence it means Mountain Waves. It is a beautiful and graceful name for a baby girl in Hindu culture.
